# LibreOffice Calc GUI Interface Description

## Application Window

- **Title Bar**: Displays "invoices.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc" indicating the active document and application.
- **System Tray / Window Controls**: Located at the top-right corner, includes minimize, maximize, and close buttons.
- **Application Menu Bar**: Contains standard menu items: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help.
- **Status Bar**: Located at the bottom of the window, displays:
  - "Sheet 1 of 1" indicating the current sheet.
  - "Invoices" as the active sheet name.
  - "PageStyle_Invoices" indicating the page style.
  - "English (Hong Kong)" as the current locale.
  - "Average: 1467.32; Sum: 1467.32" showing calculated statistics for selected cells.
  - Zoom level indicator: "100%".
  - Zoom slider with minus, reset, and plus buttons.

## Toolbar

- **Main Toolbar**: Located directly below the menu bar, contains icons for common actions:
  - File operations (New, Open, Save, Save As, Print).
  - Clipboard operations (Cut, Copy, Paste).
  - Formatting tools (Bold, Italic, Underline, Font color, Background color).
  - Alignment tools (Left, Center, Right, Justify).
  - Number formatting (Currency, Percentage, Decimal places).
  - Cell operations (Insert, Delete, Format Cells).
  - Chart and object insertion tools.
  - Formula bar with cell reference "G2" and formula "1467.32".

## Document Area

- **Grid of Cells**: The main workspace displaying a spreadsheet with rows and columns.
- **Column Headers**: Labeled from A to Q.
- **Row Headers**: Labeled from 1 to 36.
- **Data Table**:
  - **Row 1**: Header row with column titles: "Invoice Number", "Date", "Client Name", "Item Description", "Quantity", "Unit Price", "Total", "Payment Status".
  - **Rows 2-11**: Data entries for 10 invoices.
    - Each row contains:
      - Invoice Number (e.g., "INV-2023-001").
      - Date (e.g., "2023-11-14").
      - Client Name (e.g., "Acme Corp").
      - Item Description (e.g., "Graphic Design").
      - Quantity (e.g., "4").
      - Unit Price (e.g., "366.83").
      - Total (e.g., "1467.32").
      - Payment Status (e.g., "Paid", "Pending", "Overdue").
- **Selected Cell**: Cell G2 is highlighted with a red border, displaying the value "1467.32".

## Sidebar

- **Vertical Scroll Bar**: Located on the right side of the document area.
- **Sidebar Icons**: Located on the right side of the window, includes:
  - **Functions Icon**: `f_x` for accessing functions.
  - **Format Painter Icon**: For copying formatting.
  - **Chart Icon**: For inserting charts.
  - **Comment Icon**: For adding comments.
  - **Conditional Formatting Icon**: For applying conditional formatting.
  - **Data Validation Icon**: For setting data validation rules.

## Notification Bar

- **Blue Notification Bar**: Located below the toolbar, contains:
  - "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" with a "Get involved" button.
  - "Your donations support our worldwide community." with a "Donate" button.
  - Close button (X) for dismissing the notification bar.

## Desktop Environment

- **Left Dock**: Contains application icons including:
  - Google Chrome.
  - Thunderbird.
  - Visual Studio Code.
  - VLC Media Player.
  - LibreOffice Writer.
  - LibreOffice Calc.
  - LibreOffice Impress.
  - GIMP.
  - File Manager.
  - Ubuntu Software.
  - Help.
  - Trash.
- **Bottom Dock**: Contains system tray icons and a grid icon for accessing all applications.

## Additional UI Elements

- **Cell Reference Box**: Displays the current cell reference "G2".
- **Formula Bar**: Displays the value "1467.32" for the selected cell.
- **Font Selection Dropdown**: Shows "Calibri" as the current font.
- **Font Size Dropdown**: Shows "11 pt" as the current font size.
- **Cell Formatting Options**: Includes options for bold, italic, underline, font color, background color, and alignment.
- **Number Formatting Options**: Includes options for currency, percentage, decimal places, and more.
- **Cell Operations**: Includes options for inserting, deleting, and formatting cells.
